public_input.query: My partner and I are in London right after wrapping a documentary project, and we will be there during Carnival weekend but honestly want to stay away from the biggest crowds. We would love a three-day plan with quieter places where we can sketch, edit photos, and reset a bit. We both love contemporary art and photogenic interiors, and we'd like one celebratory dinner somewhere that feels a little special after finishing the project. We also don't want to zigzag across London and waste the trip commuting.
